digest.component_or_area: LLM provider framework, Pydantic AI integration
propositions: Pydantic AI 1.107+ emits PydanticAIDeprecationWarning when rebar constructs models with ambiguous openai: prefix, as v2 will change that prefix from Chat Completions to Responses
Rebar's _pai_model and _resolve_target functions emit and preserve legacy openai: targets, triggering the deprecation warning at runtime when passed to pydantic_ai.infer_model

Custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint routing via ProviderSession gates (cfg.base_url builder and per-candidate override) matches only the legacy bare openai provider name, not the explicit openai-chat: qualifier
Normalizing all inferred, configured, and legacy-explicit OpenAI targets to openai-chat: preserves existing Chat Completions wire semantics while eliminating the v2 deprecation warning
The fix requires matching both openai and openai-chat provider spellings in endpoint-routing gates to maintain custom endpoint compatibility after qualifier normalization
